entry.title: fix(e2e): delete webhooks left by cancelled runs (#7103)
entry.content:
fix(e2e): delete webhooks left by cancelled runs (#7103)

Each e2e run adds a webhook to the test repository and deletes it only when the run exits normally. Cancelled or killed runs left their webhooks behind, and once 20 piled up GitHub rejected new ones, failing every e2e-github job.

Before creating its webhook, a run now deletes earlier e2e webhooks: https ngrok URLs ending in /events. The e2e jobs already run one at a time per VCS, so none of them belongs to a live run. Runs also stop on SIGINT or SIGTERM, which a cancelled workflow sends, and still delete their webhook and close their pull requests.


Assisted-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

Signed-off-by: PePe Amengual <2208324+jamengual@users.noreply.github.com>

entry.title: fix: prevent validation comments from being parsed as commands (#6724)
entry.content:
fix: prevent validation comments from being parsed as commands (#6724)

* fix: ignore comments authored by the Atlantis account

Reuse provider identities before parsing comments, fill missing identity paths,
and separate Azure comment authors from existing command users. Keep validation messages.

Continue normal command processing when identity lookup fails, including parsing
errors. Keep missing GitHub App slug discovery optional and document the fallback.
Add focused regression coverage for identity checks and compatibility.

Assisted-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
Signed-off-by: Lee Seungyoon <omk2477@gmail.com>

* fix: bound GitHub app identity lookups

Cancel identity requests after ten seconds and retain the optional slug startup fallback. Cover unresponsive APIs and configured-slug errors.

Assisted-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
Signed-off-by: Lee Seungyoon <omk2477@gmail.com>

* fix: preserve valid self-authored commands and cache identities

Suppress parser-generated replies to the Atlantis account while preserving commands posted by automation. Bound identity lookups, cache successful results per client and Azure organization, and document GitHub App slug discovery.

Assisted-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
Signed-off-by: Lee Seungyoon <omk2477@gmail.com>

* fix: share concurrent VCS identity lookups

Share in-flight identity results, including errors, while caching successful identities and allowing later requests to retry. Keep Azure DevOps lookups isolated by organization.

entry.title: ci: serialize e2e jobs that share the atlantis-tests repo (#7097)
entry.content:
ci: serialize e2e jobs that share the atlantis-tests repo (#7097)

Concurrent runs from different PRs each start an Atlantis server with a
webhook on the same test repo, so they autoplan each other's PRs and fail
on project locks held by another run's plan. Give e2e-github and
e2e-gitlab branch-independent concurrency groups so only one run uses
the shared repo at a time.

Signed-off-by: PePe Amengual <jamengual@PePes-MacBook-Pro-M6.local>
